<script id="deen-v1062-badge-art-js">
(()=>{
  window.DEEN_BADGE_ART={
    version:'10.6.4-BADGE-HQ',
    build:'9164badgehq1',
    asset:'assets/badges/deen-badges-atlas.webp',
    ids:['first','streak7','lessons25','master','final','xp1000','perfect10','reviews10','lessons50','xp5000'],
    check:()=>{
      const expected=window.DEEN_BADGE_ART.ids;
      const cards=[...document.querySelectorAll('#profileScreen .v5-badge[data-badge-id]')];
      const present=cards.map(el=>el.dataset.badgeId).filter(Boolean);
      const missing=expected.filter(id=>!present.includes(id));
      const art=document.querySelectorAll('#profileScreen .deen-badge-art').length;
      return{expected:expected.length,cards:cards.length,art,earned:document.querySelectorAll('#profileScreen .v5-badge.earned').length,missing,pass:cards.length===expected.length&&art===expected.length&&missing.length===0};
    }
  };
  document.documentElement.dataset.deenBadgeArt='v1064hq';
})();
</script>

<!-- DEEN v10.7.4 — T key auto-correct test shortcut -->
<script id="deen-v1074-t-autocorrect-js">
(()=>{
 if(window.__deenV1074TAutoCorrect)return;
 window.__deenV1074TAutoCorrect=true;

 let triggers=0;
 let lastQuestionKey='';

 function activeQuestion(){
   try{
     if(!session || !Array.isArray(session.questions))return null;
     return session.questions[Number(session.index)||0]||null;
   }catch(_){return null}
 }

 function lessonActive(){
   return !!document.getElementById('lesson')?.classList?.contains('active');
 }

 function feedbackVisible(){
   return !!document.getElementById('feedback')?.classList?.contains('show');
 }

 function questionKey(q){
   if(!q)return '';
   return String(q.id||q.original_question_id||q.question_id||((session?.stage?.id||'stage')+':'+(session?.index||0)));
 }

 function markVisualCorrect(q){
   try{
     const normalizeFn=typeof normalize==='function'
       ? normalize
       : v=>String(v??'').trim().toLocaleLowerCase('tr-TR');

     const expected=q?.correct_answer;
     if(expected!=null){
       document.querySelectorAll('#lesson .option,#lesson .v710-word-chip,#lesson .fill-chip,#lesson [data-answer]').forEach(el=>{
         const value=el.dataset?.answer ?? el.dataset?.value ?? (el.querySelector?.('.option-label')||el).textContent;
         if(normalizeFn(value)===normalizeFn(expected))el.classList.add('correct');
         if('disabled' in el)el.disabled=true;
       });

       const input=document.querySelector('#lesson input.fill-input,#lesson input[type="text"]');
       if(input && !input.disabled){
         input.value=String(expected);
         input.disabled=true;
         input.classList.add('correct-input');
       }
     }
   }catch(_){}
 }

 function trigger(){
   if(!lessonActive() || feedbackVisible())return false;

   const q=activeQuestion();
   if(!q)return false;

   try{
     if(session?.answeredIndex===session?.index)return false;
     if(session?.transitioning || session?.committed)return false;
   }catch(_){}

   const key=questionKey(q);
   if(!key || key===lastQuestionKey && feedbackVisible())return false;

   const complete=window.completeQuestion;
   if(typeof complete!=='function')return false;

   markVisualCorrect(q);
   lastQuestionKey=key;
   const out=complete(true,q);
   triggers++;
   document.documentElement.dataset.deenTShortcut='correct';
   return out!==false;
 }

 document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
   if(e.defaultPrevented || e.repeat || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey)return;
   if(String(e.key||'').toLowerCase()!=='t')return;
   if(!lessonActive())return;

   e.preventDefault();
   e.stopImmediatePropagation();
   trigger();
 },true);

 document.addEventListener('deen:question-rendered',()=>{
   lastQuestionKey='';
   document.documentElement.dataset.deenTShortcut='ready';
 });

 window.DEEN_T_AUTOCORRECT={
   version:'10.7.4',
   trigger,
   snapshot:()=>({
     lessonActive:lessonActive(),
     feedbackVisible:feedbackVisible(),
     question:questionKey(activeQuestion()),
     triggers
   })
 };
})();
</script>
